<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915689_theRebbe_467" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915689_theRebbe_467__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Based on this, the statement "all who engage" refers to the aspect of Yechidah in the soul, which is above the concept of world, and not to the actions of Torah, charity, and communal prayer themselves.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to this, it will be understood what is said here, "all who engage, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="1">that it speaks regarding the person,</t>
    <t s="2">for the aspect of Yechidah in the soul is above the aspect of world.</t>
    <t s="3">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="4">it does not speak here regarding Torah, charity, and communal prayer themselves,</t>
    <t s="5">which need to be done and performed in the world,</t>
    <t s="6">but rather regarding the person who engages,</t>
    <t s="7">his aspect of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="8">which is above the matter of the world.</t>
    <t s="9">(This is not the case in the Mishnah in Avot, which speaks about the matter of the world's standing,</t>
    <t s="10">"on three things the world stands,"</t>
    <t s="11">for there, the matter of these three lines pertains as they are connected to the world).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Section break.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">* * *</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This further sweetens the connection of "I will redeem him in peace" and "all who engage in Torah, charity, and communal prayer" to the Alter Rebbe's redemption, which is the spreading of the wellsprings of Chassidus, the aspect of Yechidah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And according to this, the connection of "I will redeem him in peace, etc." and "all who engage in Torah, charity, and pray with the community" to the redemption of our elder Rebbe, whose matter is the spreading of the wellsprings of the Torah of Chassidus as mentioned above, is further sweetened.</t>
    <t s="1">For the matter of the Torah of Chassidus is the aspect of Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="2">And as explained above</t>
    <t s="3">(in the sicha of Yud-Tes Kislev22)</t>
    <t s="4">that because Chassidus is the aspect of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="5">therefore it gives vitality to all four parts of Torah,</t>
    <t s="6">Peshat, Remez, Derush, Sod,</t>
    <t s="7">which are the aspects of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah.</t>
    <t s="8">And therefore,</t>
    <t s="9">the preparation for the granting of permission from above for the spreading of the wellsprings,</t>
    <t s="10">the revelation of the Yechidah of Torah,</t>
    <t s="11">was the service of our elder Rebbe in his aspect of Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="12">and his aspect of Yechidah illuminated all three lines—Torah, acts of kindness, and prayer—</t>
    <t s="13">which are the totality of man's service.</t>
    <t s="14">And through this service—the revelation of the Yechidah and its manifestation in all three lines—permission was granted from above to reveal the wellsprings,</t>
    <t s="15">the aspect of Yechidah of Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">so that it would illuminate and instill vitality in all four parts of Torah,</t>
    <t s="17">the Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah of Torah,</t>
    <t s="18">down to the aspect of Nefesh, Ruach, Neshamah, Chayah in the world,</t>
    <t s="19">down to the lowest level in the world,</t>
    <t s="20">until even the power of the active agent in the passive object, and even the passive object itself</t>
    <t s="21">(the aspect of "outside")</t>
    <t s="22">will recognize and feel that "there is nothing besides Him."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
